scripts.start: docker compose --env-file backend/.env up -d --wait neo4j rabbitmq redis && concurrently -c blue,magenta,yellow,green npm:dev:*
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && node ../scripts/venv.mjs watchfiles --filter python --ignore-paths venv "uvicorn main:app --port 8000" .
scripts.dev:worker: cd backend && node ../scripts/venv.mjs watchfiles --filter python --ignore-paths venv "celery -A celery_app worker -Q celery -n shared --loglevel=info --pool=threads --concurrency=2" .
scripts.dev:worker-custom: cd backend && node ../scripts/venv.mjs watchfiles --filter python --ignore-paths venv "celery -A celery_app worker -Q custom -n custom --loglevel=info --pool=threads --concurrency=6" .
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:backend: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait && cd backend && node ../scripts/venv.mjs pytest
scripts.test:coverage: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait && cd backend && node ../scripts/venv.mjs pytest --cov --cov-report=term
